shortDescription: Creates a resource of Evs/Disk in Huawei Cloud

options.name: availability_zone
options.description: Specifies the AZ where you want to create the disk.

options.name: backup_id
options.description: Specifies the ID of the backup that can be used to create a disk. This parameter is mandatory when you use a backup to create the disk.

options.name: description
options.description: Specifies the disk description. The value can contain a maximum of 255 bytes.

options.name: domain
options.description: The name of the Domain to scope to (Identity v3). Currently only domain names are supported, and not domain IDs.

options.name: enable_full_clone
options.description: If the disk is created from a snapshot and linked cloning needs to be used, set this parameter to True.

options.name: enable_scsi
options.description: If this parameter is set to V(true), the disk device type is SCSI, which allows ECS OSs to directly access underlying storage media. SCSI reservation command is supported. If this parameter is set to V(false), the disk device type is VBD, which supports only simple SCSI read/write commands. If parameter enable_share is set to True and this parameter is not specified, shared SCSI disks are created. SCSI EVS disks cannot be created from backups, which means that this parameter cannot be True if ba

options.name: enable_share
options.description: Specifies whether the disk is shareable. The default value is False.

options.name: encryption_id
options.description: Specifies the encryption ID. The length of it fixes at 36 bytes.

options.name: enterprise_project_id
options.description: Specifies the enterprise project ID. This ID is associated with the disk during the disk creation. If it is not specified, the disk is bound to the default enterprise project.

options.name: id
options.description: The ID of resource to be managed.

options.name: identity_endpoint
options.description: The Identity authentication URL.

options.name: image_id
options.description: Specifies the image ID. If this parameter is specified, the disk is created from an image. BMS system disks cannot be created from BMS images.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the disk name. The value can contain a maximum of 255 bytes.

options.name: password
options.description: The password to login with.

options.name: project
options.description: The name of the Tenant (Identity v2) or Project (Identity v3). Currently only project names are supported, and not project IDs.

options.name: region
options.description: The region to which the project belongs.

options.name: size
options.description: Specifies the disk size, in GB. Its values are as follows, System disk 1 GB to 1024 GB, Data disk 10 GB to 32768 GB. This parameter is mandatory when you create an empty disk or use an image or a snapshot to create a disk. If you use an image or a snapshot to create a disk, the disk size must be greater than or equal to the image or snapshot size. This parameter is optional when you use a backup to create a disk. If this parameter is not specified, the disk size is equal to the backup size.

options.name: snapshot_id
options.description: Specifies the snapshot ID. If this parameter is specified, the disk is created from a snapshot.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the given object should exist in Huawei Cloud.

options.name: timeouts
options.description: The timeouts for each operations.

options.name: user
options.description: The user name to login with. Currently only user names are supported, and not user IDs.

options.name: volume_type
options.description: Specifies the disk type. Currently, the value can be SSD, SAS, or SATA. SSD specifies the ultra-high I/O disk type. SAS specifies the high I/O disk type. SATA specifies the common I/O disk type. If the specified disk type is not available in the AZ, the disk creation fails. If the EVS disk is created from a snapshot, the volume_type field must be the same as that of the snapshot's source disk.
